recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further work is only needed if PHER later reverses the FHIR-39016 no-change decision and defines a new Immunization-specific recorded element or extension.
issue_request: FHIR-34301 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 PHER change request asking to resolve ambiguity in Immunization.recorded. The final resolution was to remove the element because its use was not known and it could not be clearly defined when sharing Immunization resources across systems.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 3a84ba11931614dd0d5c39b76b26fc0b261e33c4, which removed the 22-line Immunization.recorded element from source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml. source/fhir.ini still lists Immunization as an active resource and retains only an empty deleted-element/version-conversion marker for Immunization.recorded.
additional_context: FHIR-39016 later requested keeping Immunization.recorded, but PHER resolved it Not Persuasive/Resolved - No Change and decided to stick with the R5 removal even after FHIR-I clarified Event.recorded in FHIR-39485. PHWG minutes from May 2022 and January 2023 align with that interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope Immunization source already omits Immunization.recorded, and the remaining fhir.ini reference is a deleted-element mapping marker rather than a current element definition.

related_jiras.note: A later R5 ballot request to keep Immunization.recorded was resolved Not Persuasive, reaffirming the FHIR-34301 removal.
FHIR-I clarified Event.recorded generally, but PHER still found no clear Immunization-specific need after considering that clarification.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring removal of Immunization.recorded because the element was ambiguous and not known to be used.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final PHER intent to remove the element rather than clarify its wording.

evidence_items.summary: Commit FHIR-34301 removed the 22-line Immunization.recorded element from source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml.
evidence_items.learned: There was an explicit prior application of the Jira resolution in the authoritative source file.

evidence_items.summary: Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive R5 ballot request to keep Immunization.recorded; PHER decided to stick with the R5 removal.
evidence_items.learned: Later ballot review reaffirmed that Immunization.recorded should remain omitted.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive with Modification clarification of Event.recorded comments for Event-based resources.
evidence_items.learned: This later clarification explains the background considered by PHER but does not supersede the Immunization-specific no-change decision.

evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence is consistent with the Jira resolutions and current source state.
